responsibility: This file implements the generic RTL-SSA pair-fusion pass that merges adjacent loads or stores into target pair-memory instructions such as load/store pairs. It groups candidate accesses by canonicalized base and offset, distinguishes load/store, register-file class, and access size, analyzes movement/dataflow and alias hazards, asks target hooks whether particular modes, registers, offsets, policies, and writeback forms are legal, rewrites matching access pairs into fused instructions, and can also promote existing pairs to writeback forms. It is the reusable backend engine for paired-memory-access formation, with target-specific policy and pattern generation supplied by subclasses.
same_name_distinction: Implements the generic RTL-SSA pair-fusion engine, including per-basic-block tracking, candidate grouping, alias/dataflow checks, pair formation, and writeback promotion. In this same-name pair, the .h defines the abstract target hook interface and support types that back ends override.
